svg.title: SFBRN accessibility review, decision process
svg.desc: The review path from requisition intake through the evidence, Exposure and Veracity checks to the severity state, then one lane per severity (S0 to S3) through its TAAP checks to Approve, Approve with TAAP or Deny, with five holds each held by a named party.
svg.text: Shared checks, then one lane per severity state. Each lane ends in a final decision or a hold.
